British and French forces attacked with surprise, tanks, artillery, and air support, breaking through German lines and advancing several miles on the first day.

The battle shocked German commanders so badly that Erich Ludendorff called 8 August “the black day of the German Army.”

Amiens helped push the Germans back toward the Hindenburg Line and set the stage for the end of World War I", "ru": "Битва при Амьене стала крупной победой союзников на Западном фронте.
